# layout-width

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-001 — The preview never scrolls sideways](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-001.md) — When a document holds wide content, long words or long URLs, the Studio SHALL keep the preview page free of sideways scrolling in every width mode, theme and pane width.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-002 — Wide tables scroll inside their own box](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-002.md) — When a table is wider than the pane, the Studio SHALL let it scroll sideways inside its own box, shading the overflowing edges and keeping short identifiers on one line.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-003 — The text column width follows a setting](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-003.md) — When a writer or team sets the maximum width of the text column, the Studio SHALL limit and centre the column of every preview to that width and follow later changes of the setting.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-004 — The first element starts below the top](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-004.md) — When a document opens, in read or edit mode, the Studio SHALL start its first element, whatever it is, at a uniform distance below the top of the pane.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-005 — Nothing clickable hides under the floating toolbar](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-005.md) — When the floating toolbar would cover the first element of a document, the Studio SHALL keep that element's controls reachable by giving up width or moving it down only as far as needed.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-006 — One button switches the width mode](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-006.md) — When a reader presses the Width button, the Studio SHALL cycle between Margin, Auto and Full width and remember the choice for the workspace.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-007 — Auto width lets wide content break out of the column](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-007.md) — When the width mode is Auto, the Studio SHALL let tables, figures, images, code blocks and diagrams wider than the text column use the available width, centred and clear of the pane edges.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-008 — Margin and Full width modes frame the content predictably](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-008.md) — When the width mode is Margin or Full width, the Studio SHALL keep blocks inside the text column in Margin and give the page the full pane with small side margins in Full width, centring narrow blocks in every mode.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-009 — Layout measurements stay trustworthy for maintainers](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-009.md) — When a maintainer runs the layout checks on a rendered preview, the Studio SHALL report overlay overlap, overlay clipping, split identifiers and two-line statuses, and pass when the page has no matching content.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
